name: background_needs_approval
description: run_command with run_in_background=true asks for approval exactly like a foreground command when auto-approve is off (the harness forces EVREN_AUTO_APPROVE=false whatever the developer's .env says). A refused job never starts (the next accepted one is bg-1). Old bug: the background path skipped the approval prompt, so a command still ran without asking.

model_replies.content: Reddedilen betik çalışmadı, onaylanan betik tamamlandı.
